{{Quote|Code red! Code red! We've been hit by an AP missile! A shoulder-launcher from somewhere in the village! Everyone hold on&mdash;|The APC driver, just before his death|<ref name="TOR" />}}
An [[Manka-class armored transport|APC]] '''driver''' served in the [[Republic Army|Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Pilot/Legends|driver]] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] as part of the Republic forces deployed in the [[Separatist War]] against a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]] intent on overthrowing Ord Mantell's [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]]. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the world, he was assigned to transport a group of [[Republic trooper]]s to [[Fort Garnik]], a Republic stronghold on the island of [[Avilatan]]. However, the driver was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[armor-piercing missile]]s [[Battle in Drelliad village|fired]] by a group of Separatists as he piloted his APC [[Walker/Legends|walker]] past the small settlement of [[Drelliad village]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shame about the driver, though. Poor guy never had a chance.|Lieutenant Bex Kolos, on the death of the APC driver|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served the [[Republic Army|Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Manka-class armored transport|''Manka''-class armored transport]], or APC, [[Pilot/Legends|driver]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during a conflict<ref name="TOR" /> known as the [[Separatist War]],<ref name="War">{{TORcite|type=message|Date night|Doc}} identfied the war as the "Separatist War."</ref> which was fought between the Republic and a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]] attempting to overthrow the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell's]] [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]], the driver was stationed on [[Avilatan]], an island on the planet. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] on Ord Mantell, he was tasked with transporting a group of six [[Republic trooper]]s, including [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bex Kolos]] and a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|new recruit]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] unit known as [[Havoc Squad]], from a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] to the Republic stronghold of [[Fort Garnik]] in a Republic APC [[Walker/Legends|walker]].<ref name="TOR" />

As he drove the vehicle past [[Drelliad village]], a small settlement near the [[Fortress/Legends|fort]], the driver used the walker's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] to determine that there was a large amount of fighting around the village and that the Separatists were close to [[Battle in Drelliad village|taking it]]. Shortly after the driver informed Lieutenant Kolos of the situation over the [[Comm unit/Legends|comm system]], the APC was attacked by a group of Separatists in the village who hit the walker with two shoulder-launched [[armor-piercing missile]]s. The second [[Missile/Legends|missile]] hit the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the driver, and, although none of the other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were killed, the APC was damaged beyond repair. However, while Kolos attempted to repair the APC, the Havoc Squad recruit was able to successfully destroy the Separatist missile stockpile inside the village and get to Fort Garnik.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Approaching Drelliad village, sir. Scopes show small-arms fire and enemy movements in all quarters. Separatists are definitely moving on the objective.|The APC driver, informing Lieutenant Kolos of the situation around Drelliad Village|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The APC driver was skilled enough as a pilot to operate a Republic APC walker, although he was unable to evade the missiles fired at his vehicle. He had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], fair skin, and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. His uniform included a gray [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] that left his face exposed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic APC driver makes his first appearance in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. He only appears in the opening sequence of the class story for players of the Trooper class, which is part of the quest "Hit the Ground Running."<ref name="TOR" />
